en: Colorized early-20th-century postcard view of a small European town in a broad valley backed by high, partly snow-covered mountains. In the foreground stands a prominent Gothic-style church with a tall pointed bell tower and clock, surrounded by low buildings and a square. Handwritten cursive text runs along the bottom margin, and the date "3/8 1904" is written at the top. The printed caption at lower left reads "Cles."
